about.title:
What is
Mandalart?
about.description:
A combination of 'Manda(essence)' + 'la(achievement)' + 'Art(technique)',
it means a specific technique to achieve goals.
about.step1Desc:
Write down one big dream
you want to achieve at the center.
about.step2Desc:
Find 8 essential elements
needed to achieve your core goal.
about.step3Desc:
Set specific action plans
to achieve each sub goal.
about.ohtaniTitle:
Shohei Ohtani's
Secret to Monster Growth
about.ohtaniDesc:
As a high school freshman, to achieve his dream of being the #1 draft pick,
he filled out 64 specific action plans without any gaps.
Now it's your turn.
